card.name: Comma right after a sentence-ending period
card.fires_on: A comma that directly follows a period or closing bracket, so it sits oddly at a sentence boundary. It appears in drug-label lists, citations and reference placeholders where the text continues with a new item.

modes.label: Comma after a full stop
modes.description: A comma placed right after a period that ends a sentence, before the next list item or clause.
